elements.title: T-7 repair basics
elements.text: Atlas Bikes repair-shop training. Touring models.

elements.title: Display blink patterns
elements.text: Steady: normal. One blink: low battery. Fast blinking: system fault, stop riding.
elements.notes: On the T-7, two blinks followed by a pause means a brake sensor fault: the motor cuts out when braking is detected. Check the brake sensor cable before replacing parts.

elements.title: Hydraulic brakes
elements.text: Bleed the brakes every two years or when the lever feels soft.
elements.notes: Use mineral oil only. Brake fluid destroys the seals.
